notes.title: Rita wins Renegade Innovation Award
notes.notes: [p][b]RITA[/b] was recently showcased at [b][url="https://www.queenslandgamesfestival.com/"]Queensland Games Festival[/url][/b] [b]2025[/b]! 🐣[/p][list][*][p]Players enjoyed the game consistently all day - and at the end of it all, Rita was awarded the inaugural [b]Renegade Innovation Award[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]We're very proud of this award and hope that more players can experience the unique mechanic and compelling story our game has to offer.[/p][/*][/list][p]A [b]new trailer [/b]and [b]public demo[/b] are coming soon! 🐤🧡[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029615/55fd6791b2e54cd500e046f15093e96385a03cf0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Game Expo
notes.notes:
Rita is heading to The Game Expo ([url=https://www.thegameexpo.com/]https://www.thegameexpo.com/[/url]) in Melbourne on 22-23 March 2025!

Come say hello and play the new demo, featuring:
[list]
[*] Full controller support - sit back and relax
[*] Brand new dynamic sound track
[*] Store and lore behind the mysterious "memory worlds"
[*] New puzzles to solve
[/list]
As well as Postcards to collect, SporkTank Puzzle of the Day, Mini 3D Ritas, and a Life-sized Rita!

See you there! 🐤🧩🧡
